RO = read-only. The disk is mounted with the ro option: clients can open and copy files, but any write is refused. Use it when the SMB user on the Proxmox side has no write rights (e.g. the folder is owned by root) — otherwise a copy would fail with ACCESS_DENIED halfway through.
title||Текущее состояние монтирования на: Current mount state on the router
title||Сохранить список дисков в конфиг: Save the disk list into the config
title||Запретить этому пользователю запи: Forbid this user to write into the share
title||Пользователь активен и может подк: The user is active and can connect
title||Записывать от root — иначе обычны: Write as root — otherwise regular users cannot write into root-owned folders of the aggregated share
title||Разрешить панели только просмотр:: Allow the panel to view only: settings and save buttons become unavailable
